Finding the critical fracture strain for the eutectics in F-temper aural-5 alloy using RVEs As for F-temper alloy, 3 samples are tested. Table 6 shows the fracture initiation strain (FIS) at different measurement windows. Since our modeling window is about 0.5 mm in both the height and length direction, we will use the FIS at the measurement window of 0.5 mm (FIS0.5) for comparison with the average surface strain calculated from the finite element modeling. The average value of FIS0.5 of the three samples is 0.163±0.05. For information, the critical displacement at maximum load (dc at max load) average value is 4.76±0.28. Five models have been created with varying fracture strain criteria for the eutectics from 0.17 to 0.23, while keeping the fracture strain of the Al dendrite to be constant at 1.7 (a1.7). The results of average mises stress (AMS) as a function of punch displacement, average equivalent plastic strain on the surface as function of crack length and the average equivalent plastic strain on the surface at crack length of 10 microns (C10) as a function of fracture strain are shown in Fig. 31(a), (b) and (c) respectively.
